colors._note: Every palette field is SOLVED at runtime by paletteFor(). Seeds are static (Ink: light hue #4A5568, dark hue #8792A6; NEUTRAL ground light bg #FFFFFF / text seed #1B1B18, dark bg #1B1D21 / text seed #EDEDEF). The hex below come from a line-by-line Python port of ColorSolve.kt + paletteFor; seeds are copied, solved values are 'computed'. Treat solved hex as +/-1 channel until checked against RegisterSolveTest or a device dump.

light.primary: #465163 (computed: accent = solveHue(#4A5568, bg #FFFFFF, floor 8.0, darken); Theme.kt maps primary=p.accent)
light.onPrimary: #FFFFFF (computed: first of white/bg/text with >=4.6:1 on accent)
light.error: #B23E34 (computed: red at 5 deg solved to 4.6:1 on bg and on its soft tint)
